requests.prompt: Create a production pixel-art animation atlas for an Amiga 500 side-view martial arts game. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 equal square cells, no grid lines, labels or text. Transparent background. Every cell uses identical camera, scale, body proportions, fixed ground baseline near bottom, generous margins; no limbs or weapon entering another cell. Crisp chunky pixel art intended for 32x26 runtime pixels, shared16-color retro palette, hard edges. All side-view poses FACE RIGHT, climbing poses face the wall with the back toward viewer. Pose order row-major: row1 four consecutive RUN frames (left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, opposite passing); row2 four consecutive CLIMB frames (left hand high and right knee high; centred transfer with both knees bent; right hand high and LEFT knee high; opposite transfer). Climbing MUST alternate BOTH arms and BOTH legs, not merely move one arm. Row3: idle guard, attack wind-up, fully extended attack, attack recovery. Row4: flying side-kick wind-up, fully extended flying side kick torso reclined with exactly two legs (one long leg forward, the other tucked), kick recovery, prone lying fully horizontal. No silhouettes touching cell edges, no motion trails, no duplicated limbs, no background objects. The supplied image is an art style and character identity reference only. Make real distinct motion keyframes. Character: Yamo, stocky broad-shouldered sumo brawler in green clothing, dark shoes, bare head, warm tan skin. Attack means heavy straight fist punch. Body substantially broader than Bruce, heavy four-frame running gait. Four climbing frames must clearly alternate limbs even if climbing is rarely used in current rules.
requests.correction: Correct this 4 by 4 transparent game animation atlas, preserving exactly the character, row order, all 16 cells and all poses outside row TWO. In row TWO the climbing poses must genuinely alternate left/right: cell1 viewer-right hand HIGH and viewer-right knee HIGH, cell2 both hands middle and knees bent, cell3 viewer-LEFT hand HIGH and viewer-LEFT knee HIGH (a horizontally reflected opposite-limb counterpart of cell1), cell4 opposite transfer. Cells1 and3 must visibly show bent knee on OPPOSITE sides, and raised hands on opposite sides. Clean fully TRANSPARENT background throughout including between all limbs. Absolutely NO glow, colored background or checkerboard. Keep full weapon if present, and keep same 4x4 grid, consistent scale and sufficient margin.
